parameters.operation: SELECT pi.*, ts.score, ts.color_code FROM para_items pi LEFT JOIN task_scores ts ON pi.id = ts.item_id WHERE pi.stage IN ('jots', 'tasks', 'projects') AND (pi.updated_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' OR pi.last_score_update > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour')
UPDATE para_items SET stage = $1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $2
INSERT INTO funnel_movements (item_id, from_stage, to_stage, movement_reason, moved_by, moved_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'auto', NOW())
